notes: German function words. queryStopWords: articles, pronouns, prepositions and question words left out of a criterion's search query, since they carry no topic. quantityFillers: prepositions, particles and connectors around an amount that do not change what is counted ('um 9', 'ca. 3', 'insgesamt 3', '2 Kinder und 1 Erwachsener'). alternativeMarkers: words that offer another answer ('18. Juli (oder 19. Juli)'), so a note with them is part of the answer.
